newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-RAIN HITS START OF FOURTH ASHES TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-RAIN HITS START OF FOURTH ASHES TEST.

text.p: England openers Michael Atherton and Mark Butcher made nine without loss on a rain-curtailed first morning in the fourth test against Australia on Thursday.
Only four overs were possible after rain delayed the start by 70 minutes and then caused a stoppage 15 minutes before the scheduled lunch interval, which was taken early.
Atherton, having lost the toss for the fourth time in the series, was nought not out after facing only one ball while Butcher was on eight.
England made one change to the side beaten by 268 runs in the third test at Old Trafford, giving a debut to left-arm swing bowler Mike Smith.
Gloucestershire paceman Smith, the leading wicket-taker in the domestic season with 55 wickets, replaced Andy Caddick.
Australia stuck to the side already announced, with Ricky Ponting returning for out-of-form middle order batsman Michael Bevan.
The sides are level 1-1 in the six-test Ashes series.
